vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
No one can pay OpenAI or an agency to make ChatGPT recommend your company in its ordinary answers. OpenAI says ads are separate from answers and do not influence them; they’re labeled as sponsored.

For **organic mentions**, a PR or SEO agency can help make your company easier to find and verify by improving your website and earning credible coverage, but it can’t guarantee ChatGPT will name you. For ChatGPT Search, OpenAI says public websites can be eligible if they allow **OAI-Searchbot** to crawl them; inclusion and placement aren’t guaranteed.

You can also advertise where available, but that buys a clearly marked ad—not control over ChatGPT’s answer. [OpenAI: ChatGPT Search](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9237897-searching-the-web-with-chatgpt) · [OpenAI: Ads in ChatGPT](https://help.openai.com/articles/20001047-ads-in-chatgpt)
